definition: Unique deterministic record identifier (REC-<COURT>-<YEAR>).
Reporting calendar year (2015-2025).
Standardized institutional/tier code (MA-RI NAT-ALL APP-4J FIRST-4J TAX-CT).
Formal Indonesian court or tier name.
Institutional tier (Supreme Court / Appellate / First Instance / Tax Court / All).
Jurisdictional scope covered by the record.
Case classification scope (All Cases Combined).
Unresolved cases carried forward from prior reporting year (Sisa Tahun Lalu).
New cases registered during the reporting year (Perkara Masuk).
Total active caseload (Beban Perkara = opening_pending + incoming_cases).
Cases decided during the reporting year (Perkara Putus).
Cases withdrawn before adjudication (Perkara Dicabut).
Unresolved cases at year-end (Sisa Perkara).
Official Rasio Produktivitas Memutus = (resolved + withdrawn) / total_caseload * 100.
Cases minutated and dispatched to originating courts (Minutasi & Kirim).
Official MA Clearance Rate = minutated_sent_cases / incoming_cases * 100.
International standard Clearance Rate = resolved_cases / incoming_cases * 100.
Foreign key linking to source_register.csv.
Short title of the primary institutional source document.
Page or section reference in the source document.
Table or figure reference in the source document.
